mapper.select: SELECT s.plan_name as subscriptionName, u.point_balance as availablePoints, s.monthly_amount as monthlyAmount, s.next_billing_date as nextBillingDate, s.payment_method as paymentMethod FROM user_profiles u LEFT JOIN user_subscriptions s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT id, title, amount, paid_at as date, method, status FROM payment_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY paid_at DESC
SELECT id, title, amount, type, created_at as date FROM point_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
